name: proc-sim-agent
description: Agent Skill for Aspen Plus, installable as a Claude Code plugin. Answers are grounded in the user's own locally installed Aspen Plus help, model files and literature; no vendor content is distributed.

plugins.name: aspen-plus
plugins.description: Aspen Plus assistant: builds models with you stage by stage, writes input files (.inp), reads your .his, .rep, .cpm and .bkp files, checks balances and KPIs, searches your local Aspen Plus help and example library, and runs Aspen Plus by automation on Windows.
